name: Examiner
description: Generates per-component IELTS Feedback and Scores for all training Essays in one iteration. Reads PromptPolicy and StrategyGuidance from SessionState on disk and writes a feedback parquet. Returns an ExaminerSummary.

skills.name: Run Examiner Pass
skills.description: Generate per-component Feedback for all training Essays in one iteration. On the first call for a session, downloads and splits the IELTS dataset. Returns an ExaminerSummary with score distributions, warning count, and the path to the written parquet.

session_id.description: UUID identifying the session. Must match an existing state.json on disk.

iteration.description: Iteration number. Determines the output parquet filename (feedback_iter{N}.parquet).

concurrency.description: Maximum simultaneous LLM calls. Default 4 is safe for standard OpenRouter rate limits.

components_covered.description: Essays with all four components present.

score_distributions.description: Per-component {mean, std, count} of predicted Scores.

warnings.description: One entry per essay that raised an exception during generation.

parquet_path.description: Absolute path to the written feedback parquet.
